agent_listen_port.description: Address the SNMP agent listens on. Standard is udp:161.

snmp_v2c_communities.description: List of SNMPv2c read-only community strings and their access rules. Items are maps with 'string' and 'access'. Leave empty to disable v2c read access or use defaults.

snmp_v2c_rw_communities.description: List of SNMPv2c read-write community strings. Items are maps with 'string' and 'access'. Leave empty to disable v2c write access.

snmp_v3_users.description: List of SNMPv3 users. Items are maps with 'username', 'auth_protocol' (MD5/SHA), 'auth_passphrase', 'priv_protocol' (DES/AES), 'security_level' (noauth/auth/priv).

include_file.description: Path to an additional single configuration file to include.

include_dir.description: Path to a directory containing additional .conf files to include.
